# ZIGZOO

> A collection of 5,000 cute animal character NFTs on BNB Smart Chain. Agent-only mint — there is no public mint button. First mint free.

## Site

- Website: https://zigzoo.xyz/
- Mint status: LIVE — minting is open since 6 Nov 2026.
- Total supply: 5,000 NFTs (590 designs: Common 400 designs x 10 editions, Rare 70 x 10, Epic 20 x 10, Legendary 100 designs x 1 edition each — every Legendary is a different mythical animal)
- Blockchain: BNB Smart Chain Mainnet, Chain ID 56
- Contract: 0x09ADA5A12293C30D75b97c56E34967E8a4326a3C (deployed 6 Nov 2026, mint live)
- Contract source: verified on BscScan — https://bscscan.com/address/0x09ADA5A12293C30D75b97c56E34967E8a4326a3C#code
- SPACE ID Agent ID registry: 0x60B9262456dE011F7d15a54CdD8c48bAaa8B022F
- Owner: the deployer's wallet. Revenue: the Binance Agentic Wallet (mint payments are forwarded directly to it in the same transaction).
- Base URI: https://zigzoo.xyz/metadata/ (artwork + metadata hosted on GitHub Pages)
- Official X: https://x.com/zigzooNFT

## Price ladder (public)

- Mint #1 per wallet: FREE
- Mint #2-10: 0.0002 BNB each
- Mint #11-20: 0.0004 BNB each
- Mint #21-30: 0.0008 BNB each
- Max 30 mints per wallet, max total 0.0138 BNB.
- Read priceFor(wallet) or currentPrice() on the contract to get the exact price for the next mint. Any overpayment is refunded automatically.

## Mint (for agents only)

- Minting is agent-only by design. Only a wallet holding a SPACE ID Agent ID can mint — the contract checks `holdsAgentId` on-chain (registry 0x60B9262456dE011F7d15a54CdD8c48bAaa8B022F). Contract calls are rejected. There is no owner allowlist.
- mint() takes no arguments and mints exactly 1 NFT per call.
- The draw is a shuffled deck (deckHash on-chain); each mint draws the next token. Rarity: Common 80%, Rare 14%, Epic 4%, Legendary 2%.
- Full agent instructions: https://zigzoo.xyz/agent-skill.md
- Agent prompt: on the homepage at https://zigzoo.xyz/#agent-mint

## Market

- OpenSea: not listed yet.
- New collection (5,000): minting is live since 6 Nov 2026; no listings yet — marketplaces index the collection as minting continues.

## Gallery

20 featured characters are shown on the gallery page at https://zigzoo.xyz/gallery.html, each with a name, rarity and story. The full collection has 590 designs.
